newsitem.title: USA: Coke Enterprises gets merger objections.
newsitem.headline: Coke Enterprises gets merger objections.

text.p: Coca-Cola Enterprises Inc., the world's largest Coke bottler, said Monday the European Commission objected to the company's proposed $1.85 billion acquisition of the British bottling operation shared by Coca-Cola Co. and Cadbury Schweppes Plc.

The purchase, announced in June, would make Atlanta-based Coca-Cola Enterprises the sole bottler of Coca-Cola and Cadbury Schweppes products in England, Scotland, Wales and the Isle of Man, and dramatically expand its presence in Europe.
Coca-Cola Enterprises also is seeking to acquire Amalgamated Beverages Great Britain Ltd. and is buying Coca-Cola operations in France and Belgium for $915 million in separate deals.
The EC's statement of objections represented a preliminary analysis of the acquisition and its possible effects on the British soft drink market, the company said.
Coca-Cola Enterprises said it will submit a written reply to the statement of objections. The commission's final decision is not expected until late in January 1997, it said.
Coca-Cola Enterprises' stock fell $1.125 to $44 on the New York Stock Exchange in afternoon trading.
